_meta.title: UW1 (Ironhold) macro feature network — the continuous-terrain field, dwarven forge-city warren
_meta.author: CF ParcelMap Design Agent, 2026-10-26 (regenerate with map-service/tools/world_terrain_uw1.mjs)
_meta.coords: UW1 zone svg viewBox (0 0 150.51 150.52); y down. Same space as data/hexagon-city-source/l3/UW1.json parcel centers/bboxes — clip features to a parcel bbox/polygon directly in these coords. SEALED VAULT: no coast, no sky, no horizontal neighbour — all four edges are rock wall (atlas §2.8 mapVoid); the zone's doors are VERTICAL: UP the Shaft foot at the exact centre (HUB-SHAFT's far side) and DOWN Ironhold's Gate (E wall, the boss-gate to UW2).
_meta.grounding: The upper dark: 1,233 L2 (1 EPIC · 9 GIANT · 27 LARGE · 98 MEDIUM · 1,098 SMALL) + 28,915 L3 over a 150.5 square — the most estate-dense zone of the world. The Shaft lands at the exact centre (75.25,75.26); the Forge-Hall EPIC 1091232 at (65.0,49.6) holds the Great Forge NW of the Landing; the GIANT belt lies centre-east (the Gatekeep 2091227 astride the Level Road).
_meta.determinism: generated by map-service/tools/world_terrain_uw1.mjs — deterministic estate picks (rules in the tool header) + authored control points, curvature = Catmull-Rom + seeded meander (fnv1a keys); regenerating yields byte-identical output (the tool builds twice and sha-compares before writing).
_meta.widths: zone-units at zone scale (1 parcel ≈ 0.65 u across); world-units at battle scale are derived per-parcel by worldfield.js (tier caps + floors).
_meta.vault: CAVERN ZONE: ridges[] are rock — four RIM WALLS seal the vault edges (rock on every edge parcel; the only rim break is Ironhold's Gate doorway, E wall) + two concentric GALLERY CURTAINS (R 26 and R 52 around the Landing — Derinkuyu's gallery rings) that break only at the four GREAT HALLS (N/E/S/W) and the Forge Way (NW), + four free-standing pillars. Tunnels cross the curtains only at those gaps (the routing rule).
_meta.water: rivers[] are dark fungal SEEPS (the registry SWAMP family — atlas: `ashen` stone with `swamp` pools): the Black Seep (west galleries, into the Sump), the Iron Seep (east galleries), the Drip Gallery (north) and the Deep Seep (south-east) are linear band-clamped watercourses; THE SUMP is a `fill: true` flooded hall (worldfield.js FILL water: a solid black pool at its honest width).
_meta.gameplay: units can walk over water for now (owner 2026-07-10, phase 1) — seeps are terrain/visual continuity, not hard blockers; hazard crossings come with the real-water phase.
_meta.era: Ironhold = DWARVEN INDUSTRIAL FORGE-CITY (owner-locked §3b: Derinkuyu / Cappadocia warren) — the Landing plaza at the shaft foot, two GALLERY RINGS (the Inner and Outer Gallery highways), four GREAT HALLS as cross tunnels, the Level Road to the level door, the Forge Way to the Forge-Hall, the Seam Road to the Midas Veins; a dense hold web (GIANT+LARGE holds linked by galleries) + ~18 MEDIUM feeder lanes. Towns are named for depth (Firstdelve, Ninth Landing, Lampsend).
_meta.hierarchy: roads carry tier: highway (the Inner Gallery + the Outer Gallery rings, the four Great Halls incl. the LEVEL ROAD east to Ironhold's Gate, the Forge Way) / secondary (the Seam Road + the hold web galleries/tunnels/spurs) / local (~18 seeded MEDIUM feeders, castle approaches). Roads belong ONLY to this world layer — parcels play whatever overlaps them.
_meta.castles: castles[] per CONTINUOUS-WORLD-TERRAIN §3c (castles on ESTATES; importance→size): PALACE the Forge-Hall of Ironhold (EPIC 1091232, un-subdivided → estateMapId) / CASTLEs the Gatekeep (2091227), Firstdelve Hold (2091223), Ninth Landing Citadel (2091225), Lampsend Bastion (2091230, un-subdivided — the HUB walled-city precedent) / KEEPs Doorward (3091216), Seamwatch (3091218), Southdelve (3091198), Far Gallery (3091209), the Landing Keep (3091219). Castles grow WALL/GATE/TOWER rings via maps/generate.js castleLayout. The remaining GIANT/LARGE estates take the ladder fort on their whole-estate maps when un-subdivided (worldfield.estateParcel) — MAP-POPULATION-GUIDE B-7 covers the subdivided ones.
_meta.heroParcels: each castles[] entry carries heroParcels: string[] — the estate's HERO-MODE (3D) POI L3 parcelIds (canon decision 18 / CONTINUOUS-WORLD-TERRAIN §3d): castle parcel FIRST, length = LARGE 3 / GIANT 5 / EPIC 8. Deterministic pick (map-service/tools/world_hero_parcels.mjs): castle parcel = the L3 parcel containing (else nearest to) the castle POI point; remaining = greedy farthest-point spread over L3 centers preferring parcels that intersect roads/rivers/coast (gates/bridge/harbour reads), eligible at spread ≥ 0.5× the best; ties by parcelId ascending. Estates with NO L3 subdivision (every EPIC today) emit heroParcels: [] + heroParcelsNote — designation DEFERRED until subdivision.
_meta.continuity: NO horizontal neighbours (sealed vault). Vertical links only, all POIs: UP = the Shaft foot at the Landing (UW1-SHAFT-FOOT, connects HUB↔UW1; far side = HUB-SHAFT in the Dragonmaw caldera — the world's single surface→underworld portal); DOWN = Ironhold's Gate (E wall, UW1-GATE-UW2, connects UW1↔UW2 — the FIRST lock of the Binding, warden the Gatekeeper Below; far side = UW2-GATE-UW1 on Blackmere's W wall). The Shaft chain runs W→E through every vault. The Diminishing Stair does not touch Ironhold (ENT→UW2).
_meta.creatures: kobold mining clans (each seam has one) and iron-kin smith-holds; Earth/Dark pet affinity, rare-gated underworld populations (data/zone-pet-population.json: Iron/Rock/Earth/Toxin, uncommon→legendary, domain Stone). The level boss: the Gatekeeper Below at the Gatekeep (UW1-BOSS-STAGE).

castles.name: The Forge-Hall of Ironhold
castles.ref: Derinkuyu's deepest chamber reimagined as the Deep King's walled hall: the Great Forge at its heart (the iron-kin smith-holds' seat), gate-vaults and rune-braced shafts; the only EPIC of the Upper Caverns (un-subdivided — its battle map is the pre-designed estate map)
castles.heroParcelsNote: EPIC estate 1091232 has NO L3 subdivision — hero-parcel designation DEFERRED until it is subdivided; its castle battle map arrives with the pre-designed estate map (canon decisions 4/5)

castles.name: The Gatekeep
castles.ref: the Gatekeeper Below's boss hall astride the Level Road halfway to Ironhold's Gate — the gatehouse choke of the level door (era: gatehouse chokes at level doors); the FIRST lock of the Binding is fought here

castles.name: Firstdelve Hold
castles.ref: the first hold ever dug below the Landing (towns are named for depth) — the citadel beside the Forge-Hall on the Inner Gallery

castles.name: Ninth Landing Citadel
castles.ref: the south-east galleries' citadel at the ninth landing of the old stair — the kobold mining clans' muster

castles.name: Lampsend Bastion
castles.ref: where the lamps end: the bastion on the W Great Hall before the far dark galleries — the last lit hold of the warren
castles.heroParcelsNote: GIANT estate 2091230 has NO L3 subdivision — hero-parcel designation DEFERRED until it is subdivided; its castle battle map arrives with the pre-designed estate map (canon decisions 4/5)

castles.name: Doorward Keep
castles.ref: the keep watching the approach to Ironhold's Gate across the Iron Seep
castles.heroParcelsNote: LARGE estate 3091216 has NO L3 subdivision — hero-parcel designation DEFERRED until it is subdivided; its castle battle map arrives with the pre-designed estate map (canon decisions 4/5)

castles.name: Seamwatch Keep
castles.ref: the keep over the Midas Veins — Veinsday is struck here; the richest seam of the Upper Caverns

castles.name: Southdelve Watch
castles.ref: the S Great Hall's watch-keep over the south galleries

castles.name: Far Gallery Watch
castles.ref: the far western galleries' keep beyond Lampsend, by the Black Seep

castles.name: The Landing Keep
castles.ref: the shaft-foot keep: the first thing an army from Tianxia sees when the Shaft opens onto the Landing

pois.name: The Shaft Foot
pois.note: where the Worldshaft from Tianxia (HUB-SHAFT, singular `the_shaft`) opens onto Ironhold — the ONE way in from the surface (atlas §2.8). Armies from the surface arrive here; the Landing Keep watches it

pois.name: The Landing (Veinsday Court)
pois.note: the shaft-foot plaza at the heart of the gallery rings — Veinsday's free swing at a new seam is struck here; the Inner Gallery circles it

pois.name: The Great Forge
pois.note: the Forge-Hall's heart — the iron-kin smith-holds' master forge (The Last Argument, Ironhold diplomacy, final edition, was hammered here)

pois.name: The Midas Veins
pois.legend: Gold-lust made mineral; the deeper you follow, the richer, and the less of you comes back.
pois.note: the richest iron/gold seam of the Upper Caverns (signature materials Stone/Iron/Gems; the depth gradient's first rich step) — Seamwatch Keep stands over it; the Seam Road climbs to it from the Forge-Hall

pois.name: The Sump
pois.note: the flooded hall of the south-west galleries where the Black Seep ends — still black water under a stone sky

pois.name: The Last Lamp
pois.note: the end of the lit galleries on the Lamp Hall — beyond it the far dark, Far Gallery Watch and the Black Seep

pois.name: The First Lock
pois.note: the FIRST lock of the Binding (WORLD-CHRONICLE) — warden: THE GATEKEEPER BELOW (`warden_uw1`, the UW1 level boss). The explicit boss stage: the Gatekeep's hall astride the Level Road, inside GIANT estate 2091227 — the stage parcel is the castle's heroParcels[0] (playable L3 today). Clear it to proceed to Ironhold's Gate

pois.name: Ironhold's Gate
pois.note: the level door down to Blackmere (UW2; far side = UW2-GATE-UW1 on Blackmere's W wall, Blackmere's Gate) — the boss-gated passage (atlas §2.8); Doorward Keep watches its approach across the Iron Seep. The Level Road runs from the Landing through the Gatekeep to this door
